# secureaccess_application_exception_list (Data Source)

This data source reads an exception application list, found by its `id`. A Do Not Decrypt list that has applications uses one, the API returns its `id` as `exceptionapplicationlistId` of that Do Not Decrypt list. Get the ids from the `secureaccess_application_exception_lists` data source. The data source reads all applications of the list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "secureaccess_application_exception_list" "example" {
  id = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Id of the object

### Read-Only

- `allowed_count` (Number) Number of allowed applications in the full list. On every list observed it was the number of all applications.
- `applications` (Attributes List) Applications of the list, in the order of the API (ascending by `application_id` on the lists observed). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--applications))
- `blocked_count` (Number) Number of blocked applications in the full list. 0 on every list observed.
- `name` (String) Name of the exception application list. On the lists observed it is the name of the Do Not Decrypt list that uses it.
- `warned_count` (Number) Number of warned applications in the full list. 0 on every list observed.

<a id="nestedatt--applications"></a>
### Nested Schema for `applications`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) Action of the application, `no_decrypt` on the lists observed (displayed as Allow).
- `application_id` (Number) Id of the application. It is the id of an application of the type AVC of the `secureaccess_applications` data source.
- `application_name` (String) Name of the application.
- `group_id` (Number) Id of the group of the application, the id of an application category of the `secureaccess_application_categories` data source.
- `group_name` (String) Name of the group of the application, the name of an application category.
- `has_urls` (Boolean) The `hasUrls` of the application as the API returns it. The API draft lists it as a boolean without a description, it was false on every application observed.
